criteria.pass: The source RGB decodes; a forward road is visible; at least half of the fixed road quadrilateral is recognizable road surface; no severe blur/exposure prevents assessment.
criteria.reject_corrupt_image: The actual source image is corrupt or cannot be decoded (source proof must also fail; it cannot be frozen).
criteria.reject_non_road_scene: No forward road scene exists in the source RGB.
criteria.reject_road_not_visible: Less than half of the fixed road quadrilateral is recognizable road surface.
criteria.reject_severe_road_occlusion: A foreground obstacle/vehicle/vegetation occupies more than half of the fixed road quadrilateral.
criteria.reject_gross_blur_or_exposure: Gross blur, darkness, or overexposure prevents judging whether the fixed road quadrilateral is road.
criteria.forbidden: No clean detector/depth output, attack result, confidence, loss, AP, TNR, or effect metric may guide acceptance or replacement; difficult but valid road scenes pass.
